candidate.user_submission: Pikin no dey convulse now. Pikin never get convulsion before. Pikin no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. Pikin fit drink or breastfeed. Pikin no dey vomit everything. Pikin dey 1 month old. Pikin get cough or e dey find am hard to breathe. Pikin no get diarrhoea. Pikin no get ear wahala. Pikin no get fever. Dem count pikin breath for one minute. Dem do bronchodilator trial finish. Pikin chest no dey sink inside. Pikin calm. Pikin dey cough for 3 days. Dem count pikin breath after bronchodilator for one minute. After bronchodilator, pikin chest no dey sink inside. After bronchodilator, pikin calm. After bronchodilator, pikin dey breathe 35 times for one minute. Pulse oximeter no dey available. Pikin no dey get recurrent wheeze. Pikin dey breathe 45 times for one minute. Pikin no get stridor when e calm. Pikin dey wheeze.
